name: signal-lab-apify-tools
description: Signal Lab developer-first Apify data APIs. Convert public websites to clean Markdown for RAG/LLM workflows through a production Apify Actor, using the caller's own Apify account and token.

auth.instructions: Use your own Apify API token. Calls run on your Apify account and may incur the Actor's current Store pricing; review the live Pricing tab before running.

actions.description: Crawl a public website and convert successful pages to clean Markdown plus source metadata for RAG, LLM ingestion, semantic search, or content analysis. This starts a paid Apify Actor run, so confirm before executing.

parameters.name: startUrls
parameters.description: Start URLs as an array of request objects, for example [{"url":"https://example.com"}]. Public HTTP(S) pages only.

parameters.name: maxPages
parameters.description: Maximum number of successful Markdown pages to emit.

parameters.name: maxDepth
parameters.description: Maximum same-domain link depth from each start URL.

parameters.name: sameDomainOnly
parameters.description: Follow links only on the same domain as the supplied start URLs.

parameters.name: useSitemaps
parameters.description: Discover crawl candidates from declared or conventional sitemaps.

parameters.name: respectRobotsTxt
parameters.description: Respect robots.txt disallow rules for the wildcard user agent.

parameters.name: waitForFinish
parameters.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the Actor run to finish before the API returns run metadata.
